question.worked_solution:
Given a frequency table containing data split into ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/24733a44cf365eb5e1b9257432a747a5a38e67a72d9b626e1b88f921cb9be2d7.svg) classes, we can estimate the variance by treating all observations within each class as though they were equal to the midpoint of that class. This gives
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/ec206e4f1a0ca4c7cf7a6588a6dc414820cb9ac1a46e4f659152c9b2fdd7f0c8.svg)
where

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/534dc8cbe8df49870c1b013c78b51db358835105931d1dd11bd7af060af5397b.svg) is the frequency of the ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/33f73a318016d781b6ae1aa913c2f1807ab5c7e6c2901e508fc56561fbe26b45.svg)th class,

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/929c2a5e3b92ad47814e45bba04dc753a740827c64678968b9cfe25dedf794fa.svg) is the midpoint of the ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/33f73a318016d781b6ae1aa913c2f1807ab5c7e6c2901e508fc56561fbe26b45.svg)th class,

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/fb2a8560bbc7122a4dd4f1a0bb9862d4368a63f4b03968884a3a60e7423a852c.svg) is the total number of observations, and

- ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/ff1f8ee2c66cdaacecf61d002cfb371021034fd76abd86acfb5636cb5af7d765.svg) is the estimated mean, calculated using the class midpoints.

To find the variance, we add columns to our table for the midpoints of each interval, the squared deviations of the midpoints from the mean, and the products of the squared deviations and frequencies.

Then, we divide the sum of all the values in the last column by the total number of observations:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/3bd65bbdda5a52e8695deb5df27de30003ea6055dbbccf20788217a9d467b6f6.svg)

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14266392/assets/a1ba45c8187f49efec6e7cb405a964f1070b840c2809e79362bd8617dee83d63.svg)
